latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Video Editor for Beginners Free.

- Edit raw video clips into polished, shareable 1080p MP4s using AI-assisted tools.
- Supports MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM files up to 500MB; best for clips under 3 minutes.
- Cloud-based editing with a simple workflow: upload, describe your goal, and export.
- No editing experience required; instant status updates and clear user guidance.
- Free credits provided automatically for new users.
